[9:16PM] #OjoduBerger #TrafficUpdate 

Movement on Lagos-Ibadan Expressway is characterized by smooth vehicular movement in both directions. 
Traffic congestion has dissipated on the stretches from Isheri Olowora, River Valley, Kosoko, and Ogunfayo/Ogunrun home/Ogunnusi Road, with motorists experiencing improved travel times. 
Furthermore, traffic flow is satisfactory towards Omole Junction, Excellence, Ogba, Caterpillar, Odo-Eran, and Wempco. 
The return journey from Wempco to Odo-Eran, Excellence, Ogunnusi Road, Kosoko, River Valley, and Isheri Olowora is also progressing smoothly. 
Importantly, no significant impediments have been reported, and our officials are actively on ground to manage the traffic situation and ensure a seamless travel experience.

#FollowLASTMA

Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 20 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Enhanced Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at: 5:00 AM, 24 September 2025(Wednesday)

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Zambales and Bataan.
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: Possible FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, expect light to moderate rains over Cavite, Bulacan, Metro Manila, Rizal, Laguna and Nueva Ecija within the next 3 hours.
Light to moderate rains affecting Tarlac(San Jose, Concepcion, Bamban, Capas), Pampanga(Mabalacat, Mexico, Santo Tomas, Porac, Angeles, Santa Rita, Minalin, Bacolor, San Fernando, Floridablanca, Macabebe, Masantol, Guagua, Sasmuan, Lubao, Apalit, San Simon), Batangas(San Nicolas, Agoncillo, Taal, Bauan, Mabini, San Luis, Santa Teresita, Alitagtag, Cuenca, San Jose, San Pascual, Lipa, Ibaan, Batangas City, Lemery, Laurel, Tanauan, Talisay, Santo Tomas, Malvar, Balete, Mataasnakahoy, Tingloy, Padre Garcia, Rosario, Taysan, Lobo, Calaca) and Quezon(Pagbilao, Padre Burgos) which may persist within 3 hours and may affect nearby areas.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 8:00 AM today.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to https://t.co/59mTpZJq1n.
